decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot builds closely on the firm's existing formwork automation knowledge, supporting interpretation of early results and learning.
The automatic de-shuttering robot leverages established de-shuttering and control capabilities, enabling the firm to assimilate market feedback and improve the product.
The profile storage robot is adjacent to the firm's formwork and production planning know-how, allowing the firm to recognise its value and refine it through in-house R&D.
The automatic shuttering robot directly extends the firm's shuttering automation expertise, so early website mentions are interpretable and likely to lead to product improvement.
